eligibility.localTechnical: Root adoption130e7a65 permits new owned Java and same qualified private Build evaluator plus existing JDK APIs for local internal qualification. No wholesale upstream implementation copied. Reference SDK and Python are development only.
eligibility.redistribution: No JDK/.NET binaries in product. Public release and rights clearance remain OPEN. Core public release decisions are not consumed.
eligibility.N01: CLI/XML/configuration names retained; no exported Java facade. Ledger is consumed slice only.

policy.symlinks: Refuse symbolic-link/reparse launcher, SDK root, source root, output root and JDK selection path components. Imported project symlinks retain evaluator real-path sandbox checks. No generic alias/coexistence claim.
policy.globalJson: Refuse any global.json encountered from actual cwd to filesystem root; for explicit project also inspect project parent to filesystem root. This conservative refusal covers host cwd and MSBuild project search roots; no SDK selection or parsing, even for malformed JSON.
policy.DOTJ_ROOT: Absent or canonical match to own script/JAR SDK root; otherwise refuse before query/staging.
policy.environment: JAVA_HOME mandatory; no PATH fallback, download, global mutation; reject ambient JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS/JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS/_JAVA_OPTIONS/CLASSPATH for product launch.
policy.sourceBuild: Only declared OS shell and locked full JDK; in-process javac/jar providers, ordered UTF-8 --release21 -proc:none empty classpath/sourcepath, deterministic metadata, fresh staging and validated publication preserving old usable SDK.
policy.inertTasks: Existing target declaration admission unchanged; unsupported inert declarations are explicit capability refusal, never claimed executed task failure.
policy.module: org.dotj.build.evaluation.candidate, no exports/opens; one existing evaluator call.
